0.npc_text: Halt! What business do you have at Mosswatch Keep?

matthias_ask_keep.npc_text: Keep's older than most men posted to it and in better shape than some. It doesn't need to be beautiful. It needs to hold.

player_choices.text: Ronald's wolf pack is dealt with.

player_choices.player_text: Finn is into shady stuff. I know it.

matthias_ronald_offer.npc_text: There is a hunter in the woods named Ronald. Knows the trails better than most men know their own street. He has been trying to thin out a wolf pack that has grown too bold. If you want coin, go ask whether he still needs another blade.

matthias_ronald_reminder.npc_text: Then stop talking to me and go find Ronald. If the wolves are still on his ground, they are still too close to ours as well.

matthias_ronald_offer_where.npc_text: Hunter's cabin out in the Driftwatch Woods. You can reach it from the crossroads if you keep your eyes open and your feet under you.

matthias_ronald_complete.npc_text: Good. Ronald does not complain unless something is truly in the way, and wolves that lose their fear become everyone else's problem soon enough. Here. Consider it pay for useful work.

player_choices.text: I will take useful work over praise.

matthias_report_no_proof.npc_text: Finn being the sort of man who keeps shady company is not news. Proof is. If you have none, then I do not have time for tavern suspicions.

player_choices.text: Then I will come back with proof.

matthias_report.npc_text: I don't have time for drunk talk. Make it quick.

player_choices.text: [Show Blade and Note] I found proof Finn is moving contraband through the Mug.
[Show Note] I found this tally note from the forge.

matthias_evidence_blade_only.npc_text: Let me see that. ... This alloy... contraband shadow steel. Enough to trouble me, not enough to move on Finn. I need proof this reaches back to his operation, not just a single forged curiosity.

matthias_evidence_note_only.npc_text: A tally note proves someone was moving crates at dusk, not what was inside them. Suspicious, yes. Not enough for a warrant against Finn.

matthias_evidence_full.npc_text: Let me see both. ... Shadow steel in prototype form, and a forge tally routing marked crates to the Mug cellar after dusk. That ties the contraband to Finn's operation cleanly enough for me.

player_choices.text: So we can move on him?

matthias_plan.npc_text: This is enough for a warrant. Go to Sergeant Rodrick in the Tidehunter Quarter. He will organize the raid.

matthias_raid_ready.npc_text: My men are on standby. Go to the Salty Mug. The option to Raid will be available.
